LanguageData.Gun_Chauchat_Mle_1915_RWP.label: Chauchat Mle 1915
LanguageData.Gun_Chauchat_Mle_1915_RWP.description: The Chauchat Mle 1915 is a light machine gun of early 20th-century design, known for being one of the first automatic rifles used in combat. It features a distinctive crescent-shaped magazine and is capable of providing suppressive fire, albeit with a reputation for reliability issues under adverse conditions. Ideal for colonial squads needing historical weaponry with automatic capabilities.
